abilities.name: Angler's Luck
abilities.summary: You can catch a Magic Carp in place of your usual catch.

abilities.name: At Any Cost
abilities.summary: Can spend one extra arrow for 10% more experience.

abilities.name: Baker
abilities.summary: Baking bread can award double XP.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.summary: Taking a hit can grant +12 Strength and −4 Attack for your next four swings.

abilities.name: Bleeding Edge
abilities.summary: Skilling can award double XP. The chance is the ability’s power minus your double up chance.

abilities.name: Blood Ward
abilities.summary: Casting a Blood Rune spell can cost 5 HP and create a ward that absorbs up to 30 damage for 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.summary: A swing can hit three times against a target below 25% HP.

abilities.name: Bounty Hook
abilities.summary: A catch can award twice the fish and Fishing XP.

abilities.name: Burst of Strength
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Strength. Uses one Spirit Rune on each melee attack.

abilities.name: Chaos Conduit
abilities.summary: Casting a spell that uses a Chaos Rune can spend a Mind Rune in its place.

abilities.name: Clarity of Thought
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Attack. Uses one Spirit Rune on each melee attack.

abilities.name: Clumsy Flame
abilities.summary: Scales occasionally deals a small amount of fire damage to its owner.

abilities.name: Coal Keeper
abilities.summary: Smelting or superheating can use one fewer Coal Ore. The chance in percent is 10 + Firemaking level + ability level.

abilities.name: Conserve Air
abilities.summary: Casting spells or performing activities can save two Air Runes.

abilities.name: Conserve Fire
abilities.summary: Casting spells or performing activities can save two Fire Runes.

abilities.name: Crusader
abilities.summary: A swing can grant +100 Strength for 24 seconds.

abilities.name: Cursed Strength
abilities.summary: Doubles both physical damage and the time between swings with a two-handed weapon.

abilities.name: Dark Twist
abilities.summary: A spell roll of 1 damage can become a maximum-damage hit.

abilities.name: Death's Bargain
abilities.summary: Lets you perform the Dark Ritual at the Totem of Zem and gives you a chance to keep the Cut Diamond.

abilities.name: Dragon Rage
abilities.summary: A melee swing can launch a fireball that deals up to 10 fire damage.

abilities.name: Dread Aura
abilities.summary: Can cause your enemy to skip an attack.

abilities.name: Drosswork
abilities.summary: Forging can create one piece of Dross.

abilities.name: Empowered Mind
abilities.summary: Casting a spell that uses a Mind Rune can raise the maximum damage of Wind Strike and Fire Strike by 2 for 22 seconds.

abilities.name: Enlightened
abilities.summary: A maximum-damage hit can award double experience.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.summary: A melee swing can apply the part of its damage above 10 as fire damage to you and all enemies within 20 paces.

abilities.name: Fanaticism
abilities.summary: Gaining a Spirit Rune in melee can speed up your next two swings. The effect uses a Blood Rune.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Strike
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Fire Wave
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals fire damage.

abilities.name: Flame Glutton
abilities.summary: A burn can consume 2–8 logs in one action. You get XP for each log and less ash.

abilities.name: Fletcher's Eye
abilities.summary: Fletching can award double XP.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.summary: Spells take longer to cast and deal 20% more damage.

abilities.name: Forbidden Magic
abilities.summary: A spell can deal 50% more damage. It also hits you for the full amount, up to the point that leaves you alive.

abilities.name: Gemcraft
abilities.summary: Cutting gems can award triple XP.

abilities.name: Gilded Pockets
abilities.summary: Adds three spaces to your loot bag.

abilities.name: Graced Aim
abilities.summary: A ranged miss can deal 2 damage instead.

abilities.name: Green Thumb
abilities.summary: Harvesting grain or flax can produce twice the usual yield.

abilities.name: Igniting Shot
abilities.summary: A shot can cast Fire Strike when you have the runes for it.

abilities.name: Ill Omen
abilities.summary: Spell damage ending in 4 can curse you, causing your next spell to deal 1 damage.

abilities.name: Inner Furnace
abilities.summary: With a shield equipped, stores a share of fire damage you take for 60 seconds. The next enemy to hit you in melee takes the stored damage as a fireball. Taking more fire damage refreshes the duration.

abilities.name: Iron Gut
abilities.summary: A Mining double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Mining double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Meat Pie.

abilities.name: Lantern's Gift
abilities.summary: Mining ore underground can also yield Coal Ore.

abilities.name: Light Bite
abilities.summary: A fishing action can preserve the Feather, Raw Shrimp, or Raw Frog it uses as bait.

abilities.name: Mixed Earth
abilities.summary: Mining copper or tin can yield whichever of those two ores you have less of.

abilities.name: Molten Reflection
abilities.summary: Can send damage from a fire spell back to its caster.

abilities.name: Mudwright
abilities.summary: Mining clay can award 6 Crafting XP.

abilities.name: Paralyze Monster
abilities.summary: Has a 60% chance to skip an enemy attack. A skipped attack uses one Sacred Rune.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.summary: A staff or two-handed melee weapon can parry enemy melee attacks.

abilities.name: Patronage
abilities.summary: Every two minutes the cape gives another player in your zone 2–10 of your coins.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.summary: Taking at least 10 damage can grant a Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Plume Catcher
abilities.summary: Fishing can yield an extra Feather.

abilities.name: Protector of Progryn
abilities.summary: Your active prayers can also affect allies attacking the same enemy.

abilities.name: Pulverize Iron
abilities.summary: An Iron Ore you mine can be destroyed to award 50% more XP.

abilities.name: Pyreshell Ward
abilities.summary: Reduces incoming damage from dragon breath by a percentage that rises with ability level.

abilities.name: Quench
abilities.summary: Forging steel or better gear can use Dross for a Quenched stack. It reduces the coal needed to smelt a bar of that metal.

abilities.name: Quick Hex
abilities.summary: Can speed up the first spell you cast.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.summary: Can fire an extra shot, and that shot can trigger Rapid Fire again.

abilities.name: Rapid Heal
abilities.summary: Triples health regeneration speed. Each regeneration event uses one Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Ra's Splinter
abilities.summary: Chopping a yew or magic tree can yield Gold Ore.

abilities.name: Rubber Body
abilities.summary: An enemy swing can bounce off you.

abilities.name: Sacred March
abilities.summary: Dealing damage can grant a Spirit Rune.

abilities.name: Sacred Strike
abilities.summary: A Progrite weapon can swing twice against a demon.

abilities.name: Salt Cure
abilities.summary: Cooking at a fire grants a level-dependent XP bonus and adds a 20% chance to burn the food. A burned action still awards XP.

abilities.name: Sanguine Harvest
abilities.summary: Killing an enemy with more than 100 maximum HP can grant a Blood Rune.

abilities.name: Scarab's Feast
abilities.summary: A swing that deals more than 5 damage can steal 1 HP from a target that is below full health.

abilities.name: Scarab's Plea
abilities.summary: Taking at least 4 damage can heal you for 1 HP.

abilities.name: Serpent's Return
abilities.summary: Arrows can return to you when you fight from a safe spot.

abilities.name: Shell Pockets
abilities.summary: Adds two spaces to your loot bag.

abilities.name: Shepherd
abilities.summary: Shearing sheep can award 6 Crafting XP.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.summary: With a shield equipped, an incoming hit can be capped at 30% of your maximum HP.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.summary: A shot can deal maximum damage when the target is at full health.

abilities.name: Soft Landing
abilities.summary: Cuts fall damage by 75%.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.summary: Killing an enemy with a Death Rune spell can award one Mind Rune per point of overkill damage.

abilities.name: Sour Stomach
abilities.summary: A Woodcutting double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Woodcutting double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Apple Pie.

abilities.name: Spell Echo
abilities.summary: A spell that deals at least its maximum damage can speed up the next cast.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.summary: A ranged hit can deal 1 extra damage.

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.summary: Can reduce incoming damage by 1.

abilities.name: Sweet Tooth
abilities.summary: A Fishing double up can add 2–6 Hunger and deal 1–3 damage to you. At 10 Hunger, the next Fishing double up triggers twice and consumes your equipped Redberry Pie.

abilities.name: Swift Sands
abilities.summary: Travel can finish faster.

abilities.name: Telegrab Loot
abilities.summary: Retrieves loot from a kill made at a safe spot. You need a Law Rune and have a level-dependent chance to keep it.

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.summary: Adds 10 Defense. Uses one Spirit Rune on each enemy attack.

abilities.name: Til Death Do Us Part
abilities.summary: Can block a finishing blow aimed at an ally fighting alongside you.

abilities.name: Timber Oracle
abilities.summary: Chopping trees can produce one extra log of a random type.

abilities.name: Tough Arrows
abilities.summary: Reduces the chance that your arrows break.

abilities.name: Wind Blast
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Bolt
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Strike
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.

abilities.name: Wind Wave
abilities.summary: An offensive spell that deals air damage.
